stage0085b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Most of the surface seems to be covered in artificial structures」

stage0085b_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「It's like a sea of iron...」

stage0085b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ラム$$
「All units are being recovered.
　...though $$シュレード・エラン$$ has not returned」

stage0085b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So he's burned through his life to the end...」

stage0085b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Can you hear me, Altair's Commander $$イズモ・カムロギ$$.
　This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$ of $c」

stage0085b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We haven't come here to fight.
　Return the women taken from our Earth,
　and give back the Mythical Aquarion for both worlds' peace」

stage0085b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Still no word on the true Mechanical Angel's whereabouts.
　But if Vega gets hold of it first,
　it will be used to attack us...）

stage0085b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Altair has begun its attack!」

stage0085b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「No choice, then...
　Launch all units.」

stage0085b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$シン$$
「...Can you do this, $$カイエン$$?」

stage0085b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$シュレード$$'s ultimate melody still lives on inside me...」

stage0085b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カイエン$$
「As long as it remains,
　he's still alive inside me...!」

stage0085b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「For $$シュレード$$'s sake too,
　we have to protect the world!」

stage0085b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$n
（That's right...
　We carry on the wishes of those who died...!）

stage0085b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Big talk for coward $$アマタ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　Where's the true Mechanical Angel, the Wings of the sun!?
　That kept Altair and Vega in balance!」

stage0085b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like hell I know!
　Ask that bastard $$ミカゲ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$イズモ$$
「You...!
　You don't care what becomes of Altair!」

stage0085b_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That damn woman $$シルフィ$$ matters more to me!」

stage0085b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Oh, you're mad now!
　But I'm still taking $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's not just about $$ミコノ$$ that I'm angry!」

stage0085b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you even understand!
　That someone burned his life away for the world!」

stage0085b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Not just in our world, either!
　I'm sure even here in Altair, someone gave
　their life to save this world!」

stage0085b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like hell I care about that!
　The world exists for me and $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Stay out of this, $$ミコノ$$!
　If we don't beat him and $$ミカゲ$$, the Mythical
　Aquarion won't come back!」

stage0085b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アルト$$
「Watch out, $$アマタ$$!
　Both $$ＭＩＸ$$ and $$カグラ$$ are coming after you!」

stage0085b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Bring it on!
　I'll settle things with him and save $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$イズモ$$
「All units, intercept the warriors of Vega!
　Leave $$カグラ$$ be, it doesn't matter!」

stage0085b_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Wait for me, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　I'll definitely save you!」

stage0085b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Watch out, $$アマタ$$!
　$$カグラ$$'s come back!」

stage0085b_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アマタ$$
「He's still got more fight in him!」

stage0085b_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Don't think something like this will stop me!」

stage0085b_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　You're still fighting!」

stage0085b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Here I come, $$アマタ$$!
　The real fight starts now!!」

stage0085b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$カグラ$$!
　You who cares nothing for Altair, I will purge you!
　With the power of this planet!」

stage0085b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Him...!
　He got out right before the explosion!」

stage0085b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$葵$$
「Tough as a wild animal, huh.
　Even I have to tip my hat to that.」

stage0085b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「What is that, the firepower on that white machine...!」

stage0085b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$キラ$$
「That wasn't there in the last battle...!」

stage0085b_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This is the Homeworld Total War Cannon... the Altair Cannon...!
　Altair's ultimate weapon, firing out the energy
　gathered by Iron-C!」

stage0085b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$オズマ$$
「So Altair's strongest weapon joins
　Altair's strongest machine and pilot!」

stage0085b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「This really is the decisive battle...!
　Neither side can afford to lose!」

stage0085b_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アマタ$$
「All we want is to get back the women who were
　taken, and the Mythical Aquarion...!」

stage0085b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I'll teach you this, boy.
　A person must answer for what they've done...」

stage0085b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I led this Altair into war against
　your world, Vega,
　paying many sacrifices along the way.」

stage0085b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's why I cannot lose!
　Not while $$アリシア$$'s sacrifice still matters!」

stage0085b_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Here I come, warriors of Vega!
　I'll defeat you and bring Altair a future!!」

stage0085b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We're fighting too...!
　We're fighting to bring about a future too!」

stage0085b_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「We're fighting for the world just the same!
　There's no way we can lose!!」

stage0085b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Something like this won't bring me down!」

stage0085b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Guess he's not using that planet's power for show!」

stage0085b_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$スザク$$
「So strong...!
　Is this what unshakeable resolve looks like!」

stage0085b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「All I see in that man is someone pitiful, though.」

stage0085b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「And this planet's power is about to run dry.」

stage0085b_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Eve's curse isn't the only misfortune that struck this planet...」

stage0085b_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Iron-C, which draws up the energy of the earth
　that my mother, Oriza, built...」

stage0085b_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This system, meant to bring Altair eternal
　prosperity, began mysteriously breaking down
　within a few mere decades.」

stage0085b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Losing the women, and now losing energy too...
　That would mean...」

stage0085b_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's right.
　This planet has no future left...」

stage0085b_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「That's why I borrowed $$ミカゲ$$'s power,
　and sought a future in Vega!」

stage0085b_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シン$$
「And for that, you chose to resort to war!」

stage0085b_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「As a leader, you chose the wrong means.」

stage0085b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$イズモ$$
「When two races meet, conflict is born from it.
　All I can do is keep that to a minimum.」

stage0085b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, it's not zero!」

stage0085b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't go deciding on your own that two races meeting means conflict!」

stage0085b_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$刹那$$
「What you lacked
　was the heart to try to understand others!」

stage0085b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$桂$$
「No point telling him.
　...He's the king of a world with no girls left.
　Bet he's never even been in love.」

stage0085b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$桂$$
「Asking a guy like that to understand
　anyone else was never gonna happen.」

stage0085b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess $$桂$$'s point hit the mark.」

stage0085b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Then we settle this while he's open.」

stage0085b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「A grown man losing his temper like that!」

stage0085b_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Defeat is not permitted to me!
　Not for the sake of my younger self and $$アリシア$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Why does my mom's name come up there...!?」

stage0085b_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Later, $$アマタ$$!
　If we don't stop him, both we and the world are finished!」

stage0085b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Whether Altair's planetary power runs out first,
　or you all fall first!
　Let's settle it!!」

stage0085b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I can hear... a song...」

stage0085b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$木下$$
「This is Lady $$シェリル$$'s 'Universal Bunny'!」

stage0085b_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$'s song is spreading through my wings...
　through the YF-29...」

stage0085b_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「So her feelings give power to $$アルト$$'s wings...!」

stage0085b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So this is the voice of the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$...」

stage0085b_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$イズモ$$
（This feeling... it's the same as when I first
　heard $$アリシア$$'s song...）

stage0085b_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シモン$$
「This time it's $$ランカ$$'s 'After-School Overflow'!」

stage0085b_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$木下$$
「As expected of $$シモン$$!
　Your checking's spot on!」

stage0085b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$イズモ$$
（This song is the same...
　Wishes, feelings, hope... it's all poured into it!）

stage0085b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Are these people too, just like I was back then,
　fighting while carrying someone's feelings...）

stage0085b_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「Let's do this, $$アルト$$!
　You must have a reason you can't afford to lose!」

stage0085b_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That should be true for all of us too!」

stage0085b_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Before $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ turn into
　a couple of grubby old men, we're
　finishing this, all of you!!」

stage0085b_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So your fighting spirit, once nearly
　broken, has revived!」

stage0085b_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Questions about you and Mom can wait...!」

stage0085b_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Here we go!
　We'll defeat you and take back
　the Mythical Aquarion!!」

stage0085b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And then I'll protect it!
　Everyone's future!!」

stage0085b_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Impossible...
　Am I... going to lose...」

stage0085b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$イズモ$$
「No... the moment I turned to ways
　outside the path of man, this end
　was already decided...」

stage0085b_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$キャシー$$
「It looks like the enemy commander's
　ejected from their unit!」

stage0085b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ケルビム兵$$!
　So $$ミカゲ$$'s made his move!」

stage0085b_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Neither we nor the Altair army know any restraint!」

stage0085b_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Is that bastard seriously gonna spread
　hatred at everything but himself!」

stage0085b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「At this rate it'll turn into a free-for-all!」

stage0085b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アマタ$$!
　You lot head down and go after
　the enemy commander!」

stage0085b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$, $n, $$宗介$$!
　You three search for $$ランカ$$
　and $$シェリル$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hang on, $$シェリル$$! $$ランカ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm going!
　I'm the one who'll fill the hole
　in $$ＭＩＸ$$'s heart!」

stage0085b_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$クレア$$
「Element Change!
　Go, $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Tch! Come to finish me off, huh!」

stage0085b_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What are you talking about, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　I just want to get you back!」

stage0085b_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Remember, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Remember me...! This $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Remember, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　I'm $$アンディ・Ｗ・ホール$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$カイエン$$
「At this rate we're just going in circles!」

stage0085b_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'll do it as many times as it takes!
　Until I hold $$ＭＩＸ$$ in these arms!」

stage0085b_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I open a hole, and $$ＭＩＸ$$ fills it!
　That's how we've understood each other!」

stage0085b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Why... why does repeating this
　pointless act feel so nostalgic...!」

stage0085b_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アンディ$$, there's no getting through!」

stage0085b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Any more of this is dangerous!」

stage0085b_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アンディ$$
「If I quit now, what'll happen to $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$カレン$$
「The trash pickup we all did together!」

stage0085b_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$さやか$$
「And after that, all the love talk
　we got excited about at the donut shop!」

stage0085b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Why...?
　Why go so far, for me...?」

stage0085b_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm never giving up, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Not until I hold you in these arms!」

stage0085b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I want to fill the hole in you!!」

stage0085b_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「I-I hate holes!
　I hate you so much!!」

stage0085b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I will never give up!
　$$ＭＩＸ$$! Not until I fill the hole
　gaping in your heart, with me!」

stage0085b_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Finally, I could hold you!
　My $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「...The gaps in my lost memories
　are being filled in...! My memories
　as a woman, that I'd lost...」

stage0085b_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「And the one who was always there... $$アンディ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You, did your memory come back!?」

stage0085b_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I don't care about that...」

stage0085b_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「It doesn't matter if you're a man
　or a woman. I like the person
　called $$ＭＩＸ$$」

stage0085b_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Let's go home!
　Back to our friends!」

stage0085b_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Chairwoman $$クレア$$!
　Please, take care of $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$クレア$$
「Understood!
　All of you, return to the front!」

stage0085b_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「That's a victory won by your guts!」

stage0085b_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't go spouting lines that don't suit you!」

stage0085b_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's one goal accomplished!
　Let's go, $$アマタ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it!
　Let's fall back and regroup!!」

stage0085b_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Wait!
　I need to talk to you...」

stage0085b_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Stop it, $$ミコノ$$!
　He's our enemy!」

stage0085b_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（But... I have to apologize...
　to him...）

stage0085b_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Even if the world you grew up in
　is about to be destroyed, you
　feel nothing at all!?」

stage0085b_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Like I give a damn about that!
　The planet's future means nothing
　to me! All I need is that damn woman!」

stage0085b_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Even if I make the whole world
　my enemy, all I need is that
　damn woman!」

stage0085b_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Shut up, $$カグラ$$!
　I won't accept you!!」

stage0085b_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll protect $$ミコノ$$
　and the world she loves!!」

stage0085b_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Stop this, $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Listen to our... to $$アンディ$$'s voice!」

stage0085b_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「Like I care about any of you!」

stage0085b_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$シュレード$$... is dead!」

stage0085b_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「W-what is this feeling...?
　My chest... it hurts...」

stage0085b_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Did you get your memory back!?」

stage0085b_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「I-I am $$ＭＩＸＹ$$!
　You are enemies of me and Altair!」

stage0085b_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ＭＩＸＹ$$
「You, who've trampled into this
　Iron-C uninvited, I will
　eliminate!」

stage0085b_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Damn it!
　All we can do now is take away
　the power to fight!」

stage0085b_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Whoever you are, whatever
　your reasons, I won't forgive
　you for attacking our world!」

stage0085b_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Winged boy, I have no intention of begging forgiveness」

stage0085b_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Yes... if there's something I'd
　beg your forgiveness for,
　it's something else entirely」

stage0085b_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But for now, let us fight!
　Casting aside all else, for my
　home planet, Altair!」

stage0085b_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Like hell I'll lose!
　We came here with our own resolve too!!」

stage0085b_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Our opponent is the strongest
　machine and pilot of an entire
　planet! We can't let our guard down!」

stage0085b_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I take you for one of Vega's
　strongest warriors! A worthy
　opponent indeed!」

stage0085b_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You're just like a man I know!
　Carrying everything alone, thinking
　only you can save the world!」

stage0085b_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's nothing but ego!
　You're just one person living
　in this world, same as anyone else!」

stage0085b_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$イズモ$$
「How naive.
　Even with good talent, you lack
　the experience to put it to use」

stage0085b_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that what being an adult means,
　talking as if you understand
　it all!」

stage0085b_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Never even trying the possibilities,
　just swinging your own logic
　around to pick a fight, is that being an adult!?」

stage0085b_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Taking responsibility for one's
　own acts is a full-grown man's duty!
　That's why I must win!」

stage0085b_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's nothing but an excuse!!」

stage0085b_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My opponent's Altair's strongest
　man! Now this gets my blood pumping!」

stage0085b_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Is this man enjoying the fight!」

stage0085b_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't get the wrong idea!
　I've got the resolve to fight
　for the world too!」

stage0085b_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's why I'm blasting a villain
　like you, and protecting the world!」

stage0085b_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're the supreme commander,
　act with the people of Altair
　in mind!」

stage0085b_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「My fight is for the sake of
　my people! Not a shred of
　self-interest in it!」

stage0085b_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Can people live happily in a city
　smothered by rigid machines
　like this!」

stage0085b_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you're a leader, think about people's
　lives before you think about fighting!」

stage0085b_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$赤木$$
「On behalf of this city's people,
　I'll open your eyes myself!」

stage0085b_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see. You may indeed be a powerful
　leader, but turn that over and it's
　nothing more than a dictatorship.」

stage0085b_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$イズモ$$
「What Altair needs right now is power!
　Even if you call me evil for it,
　I will fight for my homeworld!」

stage0085b_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Knowing your own acts are evil, yet
　calling it unavoidable. The stock
　line of an incompetent dictator.」

stage0085b_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll show you the end that awaits
　a rule built on nothing but power!」

stage0085b_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's defeat to an even greater power!」

stage0085b_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've stood above others myself once!
　I get some of what you're going through!」

stage0085b_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Then stand aside and let me pass!
　I must save Altair!」

stage0085b_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$シモン$$
「Try to kick reason aside with brute
　force all you want, it won't work!
　Then I'm not budging an inch either!」

stage0085b_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$シモン$$
「If we've both got something we won't
　give up, all that's left is to clash!
　But we are never gonna lose!!」

stage0085b_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$宗介$$
「This man's second-rate as a leader,
　but first-rate as a commander and
　soldier...!」

stage0085b_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Have you felt the power of me and
　$$アフラ・グニス$$ firsthand?」

stage0085b_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$宗介$$
「But in the end, most military
　regimes fall to a democratic
　liberation front.」

stage0085b_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$宗介$$
「You'll learn that a man who knows
　nothing but ruling through force
　can't build a nation's future!」

stage0085b_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Whatever the reason, I won't forgive
　you for taking $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$!」

stage0085b_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$イズモ$$
「This boy too puts his feelings on wings!」

stage0085b_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Get out of my way! I'll save $$シェリル$$
　and $$ランカ$$, and protect the world!」

stage0085b_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Protecting one you love, and the world...
　To me, who sacrificed my love to save
　the world, your strength dazzles me...）

stage0085b_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$n
「Let me tell you, dictator.
　No matter how much you reason it away,
　I won't accept you for starting this fight.」

stage0085b_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I'm not fighting because I want
　someone to accept me!」

stage0085b_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$n
「You're pathetic, you know that!
　Protecting the world means protecting
　the people who live in it!」

stage0085b_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$n
「Isn't there anyone you want to protect!?
　Anyone you want to walk into the future
　with!? What's the point in a world like that!?」

stage0085b_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Even so, I have to see this through!
　For $$アリシア$$ too, who gave up their
　life for my sake, that day!」

stage0085b_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$アンディ$$
（We're walking the path you opened for us,）

stage0085b_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（And we'll show we can protect it,）

stage0085b_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（The world $$シュレード$$ loved...）

stage0085b_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$サザンカ$$
（And the music they loved...）

stage0085b_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$カイエン$$
（Old friend...
　we'll carry on your feelings!）

stage0085b_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Why...? Watching that creature,
　my heart grows more at ease...）

stage0085b_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Those days now gone by...
　I recall the days spent with $$アリシア$$
　at Vega...）

stage0085b_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ボン太くん#pilot$$
「Fumofumo, fumomo! Fumo, fumo, fumoffu!」

stage0085b_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$イズモ$$
（...How sentimental of me. But even for
　a moment, thank you for reminding me
　of those peaceful days!）
